title: argyranthemum pumilum
intro: Argyranthemum pumilum, commonly known as Dwarf Marguerite or Marguerite d'Argent, is a flowering plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). Research has identified various health benefits associated with Argyranthemum pumilum, including its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and reduce oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and display potential anti-cancer properties. Argyranthemum pumilum contains a range of bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
